latest_release.body:
Hi, sorry for delays on this release, been a bit busy lately.

## Highlights

* feat(commands): trash command w/ undo and restore by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/1914

By default, trash is currently bound to `T`, undo is bound to `u`. and restore_from_trash is bound to `U`. restore_from_trash is for restoring items directly from the trash bin.

* feat(commands): quick jump by @stupidbullet in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2004

Bound to `<C-s>` by default. Allows quick jumping to visible lines.

* feat(commands): `select` command by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2037

Bound to `<Tab>` by default. Works alongside visual selection.

* feat(commands): invert_selection, selected persistence & undo, distinguish tagged- vs. visually-selected by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2067

invert_selection is bound to `<C-S-i>` by default.

* docs: mention Crysthamus/nvim-file-operations by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2040

A maintained replacement for nvim-lsp-file-operations. I audit the code sometimes and it looks good to me.

* feat(document_symbols): add ignore_symbols option to filter symbol tree by @jensenojs in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2032
* feat(commands): git pull command by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2045

## What's Changed
* fix(fs_actions): clear buffers when trashing by @akioweh in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2036
* fix(command): prevent focus stealing in action="show" by @jensenojs in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/1985
* fix: set winfixheight/width on custom no-enter split by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2042
* fix(document_symbols): reveal cursor position on open by @benward2301 in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2041
* fix(git): parse check-ignore correctly by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2044
* fix(git): switch ignored files resolver to git-ls-files for consistency by @Thaumy in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2047
* fix(filesystem): add link details to show_file_details command by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2049
* fix(filesystem): follow_current_file logic error by @julianbuettner in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2053
* chore: fix stylua link syntax in CONTRIBUTING.md by @Eyrim in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2057
* ci: continue on error for nightly typechecking by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2060
* fix: prefer nvim_win_resize over set_height/width by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2061
* fix: skip reveal if parent of reveal file doesn't exist by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2062
* fix: always let neo-tree open regardless of current buffer by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2063
* fix(compat): use appropriate anchor for win_set_height wrapper by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2064
* fix(commands): handle newlines in filenames when opening by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2059
* fix(fs_actions): escape newlines for filename inputs on unix by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2065
* ci: update mise tasks, use mise bootstrap by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2069
* ci: run tests/language server checks only on source code changes by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2071
* fix(git): use correct argument order for git_base callback by @pynappo in https://github.com/nvim-neo-tree/neo-tree.nvim/pull/2072
